explication: Kata Containers runs container workloads inside lightweight VMs: a container manager requests sandbox and task operations, the runtime configures resources and a selected hypervisor, then a guest agent prepares and manages the container environment. The Rust runtime, agent, and Dragonball VMM are the main implementation areas visible in the supplied tree. The excerpts support runtime start handling, resource setup/cleanup, device management, guest memory and vCPU management, and agent responsibilities; unsampled subsystem links are omitted where their callers are not demonstrated.
